title: Keep geometry out of automation routes: audit the 20 importers and enforce it with a checkstyle import rule
user-messages:
> stroke-segment route.

geometry calculations in a automation route are verbotten
create a tooling ticket to figure this out, too complicated right now.
description:
Automation routes must not do geometry: a route reads state and drives the scene, and any computation belongs in a node or a tool. Today nothing enforces this, and CRAW-105's `stroke-segment` route broke it unnoticed (it lifted SVG strokes onto the surface itself).

## Proposed enforcement

A checkstyle `ImportControl` rule in autofix (`autofix/src/main/resources/checkstyle.xml` plus an import-control file), so the build fails and ai-workspace's edit-time checkstyle hook flags it at once. It's an allow-list for `ixdar.automation`:

- **Allowed:** the mesh data types (`representation`, `io`, `bundle`, `labels`), scenes, tools and the node graph.
- **Banned:** the computation packages (`geometry.mesh.data.analysis`, `ops`, `paths`, `geometry.grid`, `geometry.tsp`, `geometry.mesh.quadlayout`, and the lifting and fitting classes in `sculpt` and `rings`).

Some of those packages also hold plain data types (`RingSegmentMode`, `StrokeSketch` for reading a template, `RingRegions` as the scene built it), so the rule needs either class-level allowances or those types moved to a data package. Work that out first.

## Current importers (20 of 83 automation files, first pass by class name only)

Look like they run geometry themselves:
- `mesh/Compare` (MeshDistance), `mesh/Holes` and `mesh/Topology` (MeshTopologyAnalysis)
- `mesh/patches/Decompose` (SemanticPatchDecomposer), `mesh/Segmentation` (MeshSegmenter)
- `mesh/skeleton/Compare`, `mesh/skeleton/CompareDetailed` (MeshSkeletonExtractor, MeshSkeletonComparator)
- `mesh/StrokeKeyRoute` (ten sculpt classes, SurfaceRidges), `mesh/StrokeLift` (StrokeChain), `mesh/SurfaceRidgesRoute` (SurfaceRidges, SculptSync)
- `ring/ListRings` (RingCandidateExtractor, MeshSkeletonExtractor)
- `ring/StrokeSegment` (RingStrokes; removed by CRAW-105)
- `ui/OutlineCompare` (grid)

Mixed or unclear:
- `ui/State`: reads RingRegions and MeshRepairReport, but also imports SurfaceConnection and tsp.PointSetPath
- `ring/Pick`, `ring/Project`: SurfacePicker, a cursor ray pick (a probe, but a geometry query)
- `mesh/Fingerprint`: ArcNetwork

Probably only read types or results:
- `mesh/SculptSyncRoute` (StrokeAnchors), `ui/MultiviewScreenshot` (StrokeSketch), `ui/SelectionBounds` (RingRegions)
definition-of-done: No automation route imports a computation package except through an allowance the rule names; the build fails on a new one; the hook reports it at edit time.
testing-plan: Add a route that imports a banned package and show the build and the edit-time hook both refuse it; build master clean with the rule on.
